name: Commercial Contact Portrait Library
description: Identity-neutral portrait series derived from the deterministic Stage 8 visual-trait generator. A portrait is a reusable visual asset, not the identity of the person currently using it. Current Koplin commercial contacts 0001-0100 use the corresponding portrait indices, while a future generated universe may assign the same visual assets to entirely different people.
constraints: Do not bake personal names into the image.
Do not bake company names or readable logos into the image.
Do not bake registration numbers or universe-specific text into the image.
The stored per-person image prompt is the current materialisation prompt for the corresponding visual asset index.

name: MineIT Mobile Generated-World Landscape Library
description: Identity-neutral 1:1 landscape tiles used by MineIT Mobile for procedurally generated worlds that do not have a bespoke authored planet landscape tileset. The library covers the full 12-landform by 10-biome cross-product plus eight visible surface-water families. It is presentation-only and never changes generated world truth.

styleLock.joinRule: Terrain continues naturally off all four edges. Relief crosses tile edges rather than forming a centred sticker object.
styleLock.readability: Must remain distinct and readable at 128x128 on an 8x8 Mobile colony grid.

constraints: No baked-in world, system, organisation or colony identity.
No readable text, UI, buildings, roads, people, vehicles or resource markers.
Do not reuse Koplin-specific landscape tiles as generic generated-world art.
Land tiles must cover the complete canonical landform/biome cross-product so presentation never needs to invent a tile.
Subsurface aquifers and hydrosphere-none do not receive visible water tiles.
